{{otheruses|the male version of the quest|the female version|Bear Club for Women}}
Olrun is angered after being defeated in the [[The Great Norn Alemoot]] and challenges you to defeat a [[Rabid Bear]] armed only with a [[Club of a Thousand Bears (weapon)|club]].

==Quest Information==
===Requirements===
* [[Guide to character creation#Decide character sex|Male character]]

===Objectives===
* Speak to Olrun about the [[Rabid Bear|bear]].
* Clutch the [[Club of a Thousand Bears (weapon)|Club of a Thousand Bears]].
* Defeat the bear using the club given to you. ''<Killing it without the club equipped will not count.>''
* See [[Olrun Olafdottir]] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 100 [[Norn rank|Norn reputation point]]s
* {{skill icon|Club of a Thousand Bears}}

==Walkthrough==
You get a hammer to kill the bear with:
* [[Club of a Thousand Bears (weapon)]]
** Blunt Dmg: 15-15
** Inscription: None
** Two-handed

Although you are given a bear club, you only have to be wielding it when the bear dies for the quest to be considered successfully completed. This means that you can fight the bear normally using other weapons to weaken it, and then switch to the club for the killing blow.

===Skill recommendations===
{{see|Bear Club/Guide}} ''for a detailed walkthrough''
*[[Hammer attack]]s can be used when the club is equipped.

===Allies===

===Foes===

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===

===Reward dialogue===
;Olrun Olafdottir
:''"I expected to find your remains in the bear's gullet, but here you are smelling like a rose. Well, a sweaty rose. I guess that bear put up a fight!"''

:''"We are alike you and I. Our deeds are known far and wide. We're tough fighters and swell lookers. There is no one else for me but you. It was fate that brought you here. Together, we will keep the family name alive! Speaking of names, <Character name> is such a silly, feminine name. You need a good, strong Norn identity. We shall get you one once you join the Olafson clan."''

==Notes==
* Female characters receive the quest [[Bear Club for Women]] instead of this quest which is given by the smitten Olaf Olafson inside the Olafstead.
* This quest has a special map zone it shares with the female version. This map zone is named Varajar Fells, but is not the same as the explorable area.
* You can use any weapon to beat on the bear, only the finishing blow must be with the Club of a Thousand Bears equipped. Degeneration and interrupting the bear's Troll Unguent work, as does spirits and traps. Using the [[Ursan Blessing]] elite skill can be effective.
* When resigning in the mission area you will not die, after the timer runs out you will be transported back to Olrun Olafdottir in Varajar Fells but you will be alone without your party members if you had any to begin with.
* It is possible by shadow stepping past the Norn Guards to explore Varajar Fells and reveal additional parts of the map by walking through the inactive portals to [[Battledepths]], [[Raven's Point]] and [[Verdant Cascades]]. However, the map is populated with foes, so be prepared to deal with them or run past them.
* Quest can glitch making the bear un-killable even when the Bear club is equipped the entire fight.

==Trivia==
* The name of this quest is a pun on the [[w:Hair_Club|Hair Club for Men]], a company infamous in the hair restoration business.
